# iaas_instance_backup_policy (Resource)

Manages an instance backup policy - a named schedule and retention configuration for instance backups. Instances are attached to the policy one at a time via the `instance_ids` set attribute. Changes to that set attach or detach the corresponding instances in place. Schedules use the explicit policy timezone, or the account owner timezone when unset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Daily full backup with up to 3 incrementals, 7-chain retention, primary disk
# only. Attach two instances to this policy.
resource "iaas_instance_backup_policy" "daily" {
  name                  = "daily-primary-disk"
  full_backup_frequency = "daily"
  full_backup_time      = "02:00"
  max_incremental_chain = 3
  retention_count       = 7
  backup_device         = "primary"

  instance_ids = [
    iaas_instance.web.id,
    iaas_instance.app.id,
  ]
}

# Weekly full backup on Sunday at 03:00 in the account owner timezone, all disks, 30-chain retention.
resource "iaas_instance_backup_policy" "weekly" {
  name                  = "weekly-all-disks"
  full_backup_frequency = "weekly"
  full_backup_time      = "03:00"
  full_backup_day       = 0 # 0 = Sunday
  max_incremental_chain = 6
  retention_count       = 30
  backup_device         = "all"
}

# GFS retention follows an explicit named IANA timezone, including DST.
# A rule keeps the newest backup in each selected calendar bucket; keep_last
# is a floor. Zero/null disables a rule. At least one rule must be positive.
resource "iaas_instance_backup_policy" "gfs" {
  name                  = "weekly-gfs"
  full_backup_frequency = "weekly"
  full_backup_time      = "02:30"
  full_backup_day       = 0
  timezone              = "Europe/Amsterdam"
  max_incremental_chain = 6
  backup_device         = "all"
  retention_mode        = "gfs"
  keep_last             = 2
  keep_within_days      = 30
  keep_daily            = 7
  keep_weekly           = 4
  keep_monthly          = 6
  keep_yearly           = 1
}
# Remove timezone (or set null) to return to the account owner timezone.
# A zone change resubmits the configured time/day, preserving this local schedule.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_device` (String) Which disk device(s) to include in the backup: "primary" (boot disk only) or "all" (all attached disks).
- `full_backup_frequency` (String) How often a full backup is taken: "daily" or "weekly".
- `full_backup_time` (String) Time of day in HH:MM in the explicit policy timezone, or the account owner timezone when timezone is null. The provider does not convert the clock.
- `max_incremental_chain` (Number) Maximum number of incremental backups to chain between full backups (0-30). Zero disables incrementals.
- `name` (String) Display name for the backup policy. Maximum 255 characters. Updatable in place.

### Optional

- `full_backup_day` (Number) Day of the week (0=Sunday … 6=Saturday) for weekly backups. Required when full_backup_frequency is "weekly"; omit for "daily".
- `instance_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the instances attached to this backup policy, as an order-independent set. Adding an id attaches that instance to the policy; removing it detaches the instance. Each instance may be attached to at most one backup policy.
- `keep_daily` (Number) GFS calendar days to retain (0-365). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `keep_last` (Number) GFS newest backups to retain (0-365). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) GFS calendar months to retain (0-120). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) GFS ISO weeks to retain (0-520). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `keep_within_days` (Number) GFS days of all recent backups to retain (0-3650). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) GFS calendar years to retain (0-30). Zero or null disables this rule; removing a configured value clears it.
- `retention_count` (Number) Number of backup chains or PBS snapshots to retain (1-365). Required when creating count retention; optional for GFS.
- `retention_mode` (String) Retention mode: count (default) or gfs. GFS requires at least one positive keep rule; protected backups are always retained.
- `timezone` (String) Named IANA schedule and GFS timezone, for example Europe/Amsterdam. Null uses the account owner timezone with legacy UTC storage. Removing a configured zone clears it; unchanged values are omitted on update. Changing timezone resubmits the configured clock/day to preserve the declared local schedule. Fixed offsets and legacy aliases are rejected with invalid_timezone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the backup policy, assigned by the API.
- `status` (String) Current policy status reported by the server: "active", "error", etc. Server-mutable; read on every refresh.
